title: canVoid grants void to every non-admin and denies it to an admin listed first
evidence: Array.indexOf returns -1 when the element is absent (truthy) and 0 when it is first (falsy). app.js:2 signs in sam with roles ["viewer","billing"]; indexOf("admin") is -1, so canVoid returns true. app.js:32 gates the void POST on this function.
failing_case: User sam with roles ["viewer","billing"] clicks Void invoice: canVoid returns true and POST /api/invoices/void is sent. A user whose roles are ["admin"] gets indexOf 0, canVoid returns false, and the real admin cannot void. The comment on line 8 says only admins may void.
remediation: Use user.roles.includes("admin") and return that boolean. Enforce the role on the server too, because this check runs only in the browser and the user object at app.js:2 is client data. Add a test with roles [], ["viewer"], ["admin"] and ["viewer","admin"].

quote: const res = await fetch("/api/invoices", { method: "POST", body: JSON.stringify(lines) });
title: Send has no handling for a network failure and no visible success state
evidence: fetch rejects when offline or on a DNS or CORS error. There is no try/catch, so the handler throws an unhandled rejection and the user sees nothing: the alert at line 27 only covers an HTTP error status. On success the handler only does sentCount += 1 (line 28), which is not displayed anywhere (index.html has no status element). lines is not cleared and nothing says the invoice was sent. Void (app.js:33-34) has the same flaw.
failing_case: Go offline and click Send invoice: nothing visible happens, the console shows an Uncaught (in promise) TypeError. On a working network, click Send: nothing visible happens either, so the user clicks again and sends a duplicate. With an empty list the handler also posts [] with no check.
remediation: Wrap the call in try/catch/finally, disable the button while pending, refuse an empty list with a message, and show a status element (role=status) with 'Invoice sent' or 'Not sent: <cause>. Try again.' Reset or mark the draft after success.

title: validQuantity accepts empty, blank, negative, fractional and Infinity quantities
evidence: isNaN("") and isNaN(" ") are false because they coerce to 0, so both pass. "-5", "1.5", "1e9" and "Infinity" also pass. app.js:19-20 pushes Number(qtyText). The field has no min or step (index.html:16) and the comment on guards.js:16 only says a number.
failing_case: Leave Quantity blank, enter price 10, click Add line: a line with qty 0 is added. Enter qty -5, price 10: the total becomes -50.00, and Send invoice posts a credit line. Enter qty Infinity: the total shows Infinity.
remediation: Parse once: const n = Number(text); accept only text.trim() !== "" && Number.isInteger(n) && n > 0 && n <= a stated maximum. Reject Infinity. Add a test table for "", " ", "-1", "0", "1.5", "Infinity", "3".

title: lastSend is never updated, so tooSoon never blocks and the invoice can be sent twice
evidence: grep of the payload: lastSend is assigned only at its declaration (guards.js:22) and read in tooSoon (guards.js:24). Date.now() minus 0 is always far above 1000, so tooSoon always returns false. app.js:25 relies on it, and the click handler at app.js:24 sets no in-flight flag and does not disable the button.
failing_case: Double-click Send invoice. Both clicks pass tooSoon(), two POST /api/invoices requests carry the same lines, and the customer is billed twice. sentCount reaches 2.
remediation: Set the in-flight state before the await (disable the button and clear it in finally), and send an idempotency key the server de-duplicates. If the timer stays, set lastSend = Date.now() inside the guard.

title: Invalid quantity or price is dropped silently; Add line looks dead
evidence: The submit handler returns with no message, no aria-invalid and no focus move. The inputs (index.html:16,18) are plain text with no required or constraints for qty and price.
failing_case: Type Quantity 2 and Unit price abc (or 0, or blank) and press Add line: nothing is added and nothing explains why. A keyboard or screen-reader user gets no feedback at all.
remediation: On failure set aria-invalid on the field, show a message next to it ("Unit price must be greater than 0"), and focus the first bad field. Prefer native required/min attributes.

quote: const total = lines.reduce((sum, l) => sum + l.qty * l.price, 0);
title: Money is summed as floating point inside render, and the displayed unit price can disagree with the total
evidence: The total rule lives in render() (view code) and uses binary floats. price is accepted at any precision (app.js:18-19) but displayed with toFixed(2) at line 8.
failing_case: Add qty 3 at unit price 0.004: the line shows 3 × 0.00 while the total shows 0.01. Many lines at 0.1 accumulate float error that toFixed hides only partly. The sent payload (line 26) carries the raw floats, so the server and the screen can differ.
remediation: Move totals into one pure, tested function that works in integer minor units, round the price to cents at input, and send those integers.

title: Void is a one-click destructive action with no confirmation, no target and no success state
evidence: index.html:24 renders Void invoice next to Send invoice with identical styling (styles.css:4). The request body names no invoice. The handler gives no feedback on success (line 34 handles only failure). For a user who fails canVoid the click silently does nothing.
failing_case: A mis-click next to Send invoice voids an invoice immediately. The request carries no invoice id, so the server cannot tell which invoice is meant. The user sees no confirmation either way.
remediation: Send the invoice id in the body, ask for confirmation naming the invoice, show a result message, and hide or disable Void (with a reason) for users who may not use it.

title: escapeHtml does not escape quotes, but app.js puts its output inside a double-quoted attribute
evidence: app.js:8 builds title="${escapeHtml(l.client)}" and assigns the string to innerHTML at app.js:7. escapeHtml escapes only & < >, so a double quote in the client name closes the attribute. The client field (index.html:14) accepts any text.
failing_case: Enter the client name x" onmouseover="alert(document.cookie) and any valid qty and price, then click Add line. The rendered markup is <a href="#" title="x" onmouseover="alert(document.cookie)">, and the script runs when the pointer moves over the link. Same with autofocus onfocus=... for no-click execution.
remediation: Escape " and ' as " and ' in escapeHtml, or stop building HTML strings: create the li and a elements with createElement and set textContent and the title property. Add a test that feeds " onmouseover=" through render.
fix: not offerable: unbalanced brackets or quotes

title: Unsent invoice lines live only in memory and are lost on refresh or tab close
evidence: lines is a module-level array. There is no localStorage, no beforeunload warning and no pagehide flush anywhere in the four files.
failing_case: Enter ten lines, accidentally press F5 or close the tab: all ten lines are gone, with no warning.
remediation: Save lines to storage on each change (guarded load, versioned shape) or warn with beforeunload while lines exist.

title: Each line's client name is a link to nothing: a tab stop that scrolls to the top
evidence: The anchor has href="#" and no click handler anywhere (app.js has no listener on the list). The title repeats the visible text.
failing_case: Tab through the page after adding five lines: five extra focus stops that announce as "link". Activating one with Enter jumps the page to the top and adds #/ to the URL, doing nothing else.
remediation: Render the client name as plain text, or give it a real target and handler. Drop the redundant title.

title: The whole list is a live region that is rebuilt with innerHTML, so screen readers re-read every line on each add
evidence: render() (app.js:7) replaces all children on every add. A polite region whose content is replaced is announced as a whole by many screen readers. The total in an output element (index.html:22) is not announced separately and there is no error or sent-status region (WCAG 4.1.3, AA).
failing_case: A screen-reader user adds the 20th line: all 20 lines are announced again. When Send or Void fails or succeeds, nothing is announced, since only an alert() or nothing is used.
remediation: Append only the new li (or announce a short 'Line added: client, total' in a separate role=status element) and use that element for send, void and validation results.
